figures.caption: Figure 3. Episode selection and preprocessing pipeline. SR normalization windows (hour 0–1) are disjoint from classification windows (hours 1–2), ensuring the RobustScaler has no access to labeled data. The ≥ 4 hr SR inclusion criterion further ensures that all SR classification windows begin at least 2 hr before AF onset, reducing the risk of including pre-episode transitional rhythms.
Figure 4. Encoder architecture: multi-branch 1D-CNN backbone with temporal attention pooling and a two-layer MLP projection head.
Table 2. Embedding-space metrics on the test set (mean ± std, 5 seeds). Per patient SR cohesion is the primary metric. Bold = best per row. ↑ higher is better; ↓ lower is better.
